description: A Cursor postToolUse body for a Write call. Proves observe.toolResult and observe.fileEdit: the event becomes file.edited with a repo-relative path, and the file contents — deliberately carrying credentials — appear nowhere in the envelope. It is also the fixture that pins the `event` spelling of the event name, which is why the codec declares eventNamePaths rather than a single path.
